queries.title: Five-table inner join — the student master record, fully resolved
queries.sql:
SELECT s.roll_number,
       CONCAT(s.first_name, ' ', IFNULL(s.middle_name, ''), ' ', s.last_name) AS student_name,
       s.email,
       d.department_code,
       d.name            AS department_name,
       p.program_code,
       p.name            AS program_name,
       b.batch_code,
       c.name            AS category,
       s.current_semester_no,
       s.admission_year,
       s.status
FROM   students    s
JOIN   departments d ON d.department_id = s.department_id
JOIN   programs    p ON p.program_id    = s.program_id
JOIN   batches     b ON b.batch_id      = s.batch_id
JOIN   categories  c ON c.category_id   = s.category_id
WHERE  s.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER  BY d.department_code, s.roll_number
LIMIT  50;

queries.title: Six-table join — who teaches what to whom, and how many enrolled
queries.sql:
SELECT sub.subject_code,
       sub.name                                        AS subject_name,
       sub.credits,
       CONCAT(f.first_name, ' ', f.last_name)          AS faculty_name,
       f.employee_code,
       p.program_code,
       sec.section_code,
       sem.name                                        AS semester,
       o.enrolled_count,
       o.capacity,
       ROUND(o.enrolled_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(o.capacity, 0), 1) AS fill_percentage
FROM   course_offerings o
JOIN   subjects    sub ON sub.subject_id  = o.subject_id
JOIN   faculty     f   ON f.faculty_id    = o.faculty_id
JOIN   programs    p   ON p.program_id    = o.program_id
JOIN   semesters   sem ON sem.semester_id = o.semester_id
LEFT   JOIN sections sec ON sec.section_id = o.section_id
WHERE  o.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER  BY sub.subject_code, p.program_code
LIMIT  60;

queries.title: LEFT JOIN with a status predicate in ON (not WHERE) — residents vs
queries.sql:
SELECT s.roll_number,
       CONCAT(s.first_name, ' ', s.last_name) AS student_name,
       CASE WHEN ra.allocation_id IS NULL THEN 'DAY SCHOLAR' ELSE 'RESIDENT' END AS residency,
       h.name        AS hostel,
       h.hostel_code,
       r.room_number,
       bd.bed_code,
       ra.allocated_on
FROM   students s
LEFT   JOIN room_allocations ra
       ON  ra.student_id = s.student_id
       AND ra.status      = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT   JOIN hostels h ON h.hostel_id = ra.hostel_id
LEFT   JOIN rooms   r ON r.room_id   = ra.room_id
LEFT   JOIN beds    bd ON bd.bed_id  = ra.bed_id
WHERE  s.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER  BY residency, h.hostel_code, r.room_number
LIMIT  60;

queries.title: Self join — every department with the name of its HOD

       d.name                                    AS department,
       CONCAT(h.first_name, ' ', h.last_name)    AS hod_name,

queries.title: Anti-join #1 (LEFT JOIN … IS NULL) — active students who have not
queries.sql:
SELECT s.roll_number,
       CONCAT(s.first_name, ' ', s.last_name) AS student_name,
       s.current_semester_no
FROM   students s
LEFT   JOIN enrollments e
       ON  e.student_id = s.student_id
       AND e.status      = 'ENROLLED'
       AND e.offering_id IN (SELECT o.offering_id
                             FROM   course_offerings o
                             WHERE  o.semester_id = (SELECT semester_id
                                                     FROM   semesters
                                                     WHERE  is_current = 1
                                                     LIMIT  1))
WHERE  s.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND  e.enrollment_id IS NULL
ORDER  BY s.roll_number;

queries.title: Fee ledger with aggregated payments — one row per student bill
queries.sql:
SELECT s.roll_number,
       CONCAT(s.first_name, ' ', s.last_name)                       AS student_name,
       sf.student_fee_id,
       sf.total_amount,
       sf.scholarship_amount,
       sf.fine_amount,
       sf.paid_amount,
       sf.due_amount,
       sf.status,
       sf.due_date,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments py WHERE py.student_fee_id = sf.student_fee_id AND py.status = 'SUCCESS') AS receipts,
       DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), sf.due_date)                              AS days_overdue
FROM   student_fees sf
JOIN   students s ON s.student_id = sf.student_id
WHERE  sf.status <> 'PAID'
ORDER  BY days_overdue DESC

queries.title: Result sheet join — marks traced back to exam, schedule and subject
queries.sql:
SELECT e.exam_code,
       es.exam_date,
       sub.subject_code,
       sub.name                                 AS subject_name,
       s.roll_number,
       CONCAT(s.first_name, ' ', s.last_name)   AS student_name,
       m.marks_obtained,
       m.max_marks,
       m.grade,
       m.grade_points
FROM   marks m
JOIN   exam_registrations er ON er.registration_id = m.registration_id
JOIN   exams               e ON e.exam_id          = er.exam_id
JOIN   exam_schedules      es ON es.schedule_id    = er.schedule_id
JOIN   course_offerings    o  ON o.offering_id     = er.offering_id
JOIN   subjects            sub ON sub.subject_id   = o.subject_id
JOIN   students            s  ON s.student_id      = er.student_id
WHERE  e.exam_type = 'ENDSEM'
ORDER  BY e.exam_code, sub.subject_code, s.roll_number
LIMIT  60;

queries.title: Department strength with a HAVING filter on the group
queries.sql:
SELECT d.department_code,
       d.name                             AS department,
       COUNT(*)                           AS students,
       SUM(s.gender = 'MALE')             AS male,
       SUM(s.gender = 'FEMALE')           AS female,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.program_id)       AS programs,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.batch_id)         AS batches
FROM   students s
JOIN   departments d ON d.department_id = s.department_id
WHERE  s.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP  BY d.department_id, d.department_code, d.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER  BY students DESC;

queries.title: Subjects where more than 20% of the class failed (exam-cell watchlist)
queries.sql:
SELECT sub.subject_code,
       sub.name                                                        AS subject_name,
       COUNT(*)                                                        AS attempts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_pass = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                  AS passed,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_pass = 0 OR m.is_absent = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed,
       ROUND(AVG(m.percentage), 2)                                     AS avg_percentage,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_pass = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pass_percentage
FROM   marks m
JOIN   exam_registrations er ON er.registration_id = m.registration_id
JOIN   course_offerings   o  ON o.offering_id      = er.offering_id
JOIN   subjects           sub ON sub.subject_id    = o.subject_id
GROUP  BY sub.subject_id, sub.subject_code, sub.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
   AND (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_pass = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) < 80
ORDER  BY pass_percentage ASC;

queries.title: Two CTEs joined together — the "at-risk" list (academics + money)
queries.sql:
WITH attendance_cte AS (
        SELECT s.student_id,
               ROUND(100.0 * SUM(a.status = 'PRESENT') / COUNT(*), 2) AS attendance_pct
        FROM   attendance a
        JOIN   students s ON s.student_id = a.student_id
        GROUP  BY s.student_id),
     dues_cte AS (
        SELECT sf.student_id,
               SUM(sf.due_amount)                     AS pending_fees,
               SUM(CASE WHEN sf.due_date < CURDATE() THEN sf.due_amount ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_fees
        FROM   student_fees sf
        WHERE  sf.status <> 'PAID'
        GROUP  BY sf.student_id)
SELECT s.roll_number,
       CONCAT(s.first_name, ' ', s.last_name)                        AS student_name,
       d.department_code,
       COALESCE(ac.attendance_pct, 0)                                AS attendance_pct,
       COALESCE(dc.pending_fees, 0)                                  AS pending_fees,
       COALESCE(r.backlog_count, 0)                                  AS backlogs,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(ac.attendance_pct, 0) < 75 AND COALESCE(dc.pending_fees, 0) > 0 THEN 'CRITICAL'
            WHEN COALESCE(ac.attendance_pct, 0) < 75 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN COALESCE(dc.pending_fees, 0) > 0    THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW' END                                           AS risk_level
FROM   students s
JOIN   departments d ON d.department_id = s.department_id
LEFT   JOIN attendance_cte ac ON ac.student_id = s.student_id
LEFT   JOIN dues_cte       dc ON dc.student_id = s.student_id
LEFT   JOIN results        r  ON r.student_id  = s.student_id
                             AND r.result_id   = (SELECT r2.result_id FROM results r2
                                                  WHERE r2.student_id = s.student_id
                                                  ORDER BY r2.published_on DESC, r2.result_id DESC
                                                  LIMIT 1)
WHERE  s.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER  BY FIELD(risk_level, 'CRITICAL', 'HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW'), pending_fees DESC
LIMIT  50;

queries.title: LAG / LEAD — month-on-month fee collection growth
queries.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(p.payment_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
               SUM(p.amount)                        AS collected,
               COUNT(*)                             AS receipts

SELECT month,
       receipts,
       collected,
       LAG(collected)  OVER (ORDER BY month)                       AS previous_month,
       collected - LAG(collected) OVER (ORDER BY month)            AS delta,

             / NULLIF(LAG(collected) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 1) AS growth_percentage,

queries.title: Exam eligibility — the rule enforced by
queries.sql:
WITH att AS (
        SELECT a.student_id,
               a.offering_id,
               COUNT(*)                                        AS sessions,
               SUM(a.status = 'PRESENT')                       AS present,
               ROUND(100.0 * SUM(a.status = 'PRESENT') / COUNT(*), 2) AS attendance_pct
        FROM   attendance a
        GROUP  BY a.student_id, a.offering_id),
     dues AS (
        SELECT sf.student_id, SUM(sf.due_amount) AS pending_fees
        FROM   student_fees sf
        WHERE  sf.status <> 'PAID'
        GROUP  BY sf.student_id)
SELECT s.roll_number,
       CONCAT(s.first_name, ' ', s.last_name)     AS student_name,
       sub.subject_code,
       e.exam_code,
       att.attendance_pct,
       e.min_attendance_required,
       COALESCE(dues.pending_fees, 0)             AS pending_fees,
       CASE WHEN att.attendance_pct IS NULL                       THEN 'NO ATTENDANCE RECORD'
            WHEN att.attendance_pct < e.min_attendance_required   THEN 'BLOCKED — ATTENDANCE SHORT'
            WHEN COALESCE(dues.pending_fees, 0) > 0               THEN 'BLOCKED — FEES PENDING'
            ELSE 'ELIGIBLE' END                   AS verdict
FROM   exams e
JOIN   exam_schedules   es  ON es.exam_id     = e.exam_id
JOIN   subjects         sub ON sub.subject_id = es.subject_id
JOIN   course_offerings o   ON o.subject_id   = es.subject_id
                           AND o.program_id   = es.program_id
JOIN   enrollments      en  ON en.offering_id = o.offering_id AND en.status = 'ENROLLED'
JOIN   students         s   ON s.student_id   = en.student_id
LEFT   JOIN att  ON att.student_id  = s.student_id  AND att.offering_id  = o.offering_id
LEFT   JOIN dues ON dues.student_id = s.student_id
WHERE  e.status IN ('SCHEDULED', 'REGISTRATION_OPEN', 'ONGOING')
ORDER  BY FIELD(verdict, 'BLOCKED — ATTENDANCE SHORT', 'BLOCKED — FEES PENDING',
                         'NO ATTENDANCE RECORD', 'ELIGIBLE'),
         att.attendance_pct ASC
LIMIT  60;

queries.title: Hostel vacancy board with running occupancy per hostel
queries.sql:
SELECT h.hostel_code,
       b.block_code,
       r.room_number,
       r.room_type,
       r.capacity,
       r.occupied_count,
       r.capacity - r.occupied_count                                            AS free_beds,
       SUM(r.occupied_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.hostel_id
                                   ORDER BY b.block_code, r.room_number
                                   ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_occupancy,
       CASE WHEN r.occupied_count = 0              THEN 'VACANT'
            WHEN r.occupied_count >= r.capacity    THEN 'FULL'
            ELSE 'PARTIAL' END                                                  AS room_state,
       r.status
FROM   rooms r
JOIN   hostels       h ON h.hostel_id = r.hostel_id
LEFT   JOIN hostel_blocks b ON b.block_id = r.block_id
ORDER  BY h.hostel_code, b.block_code, r.room_number
LIMIT  80;

queries.title: Fee ageing buckets (0-30 / 31-90 / 91-180 / 180+) per program
queries.sql:
WITH aged AS (
        SELECT s.program_id,
               p.program_code,
               DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), sf.due_date) AS days,
               sf.due_amount
        FROM   student_fees sf
        JOIN   students s ON s.student_id = sf.student_id
        JOIN   programs p ON p.program_id = s.program_id
        WHERE  sf.status <> 'PAID' AND sf.due_amount > 0)
SELECT program_code,
       COUNT(*)                                                             AS overdue_bills,
       SUM(due_amount)                                                      AS total_due,
       SUM(CASE WHEN days <= 30  THEN due_amount ELSE 0 END)                AS bucket_0_30,
       SUM(CASE WHEN days BETWEEN 31 AND 90  THEN due_amount ELSE 0 END)    AS bucket_31_90,
       SUM(CASE WHEN days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN due_amount ELSE 0 END)    AS bucket_91_180,
       SUM(CASE WHEN days > 180 THEN due_amount ELSE 0 END)                 AS bucket_180_plus
FROM   aged
GROUP  BY program_id, program_code
ORDER  BY total_due DESC;

queries.title: Payroll register with year-to-date totals per faculty
queries.sql:
SELECT f.employee_code,
       CONCAT(f.first_name, ' ', f.last_name)                          AS faculty_name,
       d.department_code,
       py.pay_year,
       py.pay_month,
       py.gross_salary,
       py.net_salary,
       SUM(py.net_salary) OVER (PARTITION BY f.faculty_id, py.pay_year
                                ORDER BY py.pay_month
                                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ytd_net,
       py.net_salary - LAG(py.net_salary) OVER (PARTITION BY f.faculty_id
                                                ORDER BY py.pay_year, py.pay_month) AS month_delta,
       py.lop_days,
       py.status
FROM   payrolls py
JOIN   faculty     f ON f.faculty_id    = py.faculty_id
JOIN   departments d ON d.department_id = f.department_id
ORDER  BY f.employee_code, py.pay_year DESC, py.pay_month DESC

queries.title: Leave utilisation vs sanctioned quota (uses the UDF)
queries.sql:
SELECT f.employee_code,
       CONCAT(f.first_name, ' ', f.last_name)              AS faculty_name,
       lb.leave_type,
       lb.allotted,
       lb.used,
       lb.allotted - lb.used                               AS remaining_ledger,
       fn_calculate_faculty_leave_balance(
         f.faculty_id, lb.leave_type,
         (SELECT academic_year_id FROM academic_years WHERE is_current = 1 LIMIT 1)
       )                                                   AS remaining_udf,
       ROUND(100.0 * lb.used / NULLIF(lb.allotted, 0), 1)  AS utilisation_percentage,
       CASE WHEN lb.used >= lb.allotted      THEN 'EXHAUSTED'
            WHEN lb.used >= 0.8 * lb.allotted THEN 'LOW BALANCE'
            ELSE 'HEALTHY' END                             AS health
FROM   leave_balances lb
JOIN   faculty f ON f.faculty_id = lb.faculty_id
ORDER  BY health DESC, utilisation_percentage DESC
LIMIT  60;

queries.title: Timetable clash detection — the query behind the conflict API
queries.sql:
SELECT 'FACULTY'                                            AS clash_type,
       f.employee_code,
       CONCAT(f.first_name, ' ', f.last_name)               AS faculty_name,
       t1.day_of_week,
       t1.start_time,
       t1.end_time,
       t1.room_number                                       AS room_a,
       t2.room_number                                       AS room_b,
       s1.subject_code                                      AS subject_a,
       s2.subject_code                                      AS subject_b
FROM   timetable t1
JOIN   timetable t2
       ON  t1.faculty_id  = t2.faculty_id
       AND t1.timetable_id < t2.timetable_id
       AND t1.day_of_week = t2.day_of_week
       AND t1.start_time  < t2.end_time
       AND t2.start_time  < t1.end_time
       AND t1.is_active   = 1
       AND t2.is_active   = 1
JOIN   faculty            f  ON f.faculty_id   = t1.faculty_id
JOIN   course_offerings   o1 ON o1.offering_id = t1.offering_id
JOIN   subjects           s1 ON s1.subject_id  = o1.subject_id
JOIN   course_offerings   o2 ON o2.offering_id = t2.offering_id
JOIN   subjects           s2 ON s2.subject_id  = o2.subject_id

UNION ALL

SELECT 'ROOM',
       f.employee_code,
       CONCAT(f.first_name, ' ', f.last_name),
       t1.day_of_week,
       t1.start_time,
       t1.end_time,
       t1.room_number,
       t2.room_number,
       s1.subject_code,
       s2.subject_code
FROM   timetable t1
JOIN   timetable t2
       ON  t1.room_number  = t2.room_number
       AND t1.timetable_id < t2.timetable_id
       AND t1.day_of_week  = t2.day_of_week
       AND t1.start_time   < t2.end_time
       AND t2.start_time   < t1.end_time
       AND t1.is_active    = 1
       AND t2.is_active    = 1
JOIN   faculty          f  ON f.faculty_id   = t1.faculty_id
JOIN   course_offerings o1 ON o1.offering_id = t1.offering_id
JOIN   subjects         s1 ON s1.subject_id  = o1.subject_id
JOIN   course_offerings o2 ON o2.offering_id = t2.offering_id
JOIN   subjects         s2 ON s2.subject_id  = o2.subject_id
ORDER  BY clash_type, day_of_week, start_time;

queries.title: Attendance trend per student — month over month with LAG
queries.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
        SELECT a.student_id,
               DATE_FORMAT(cs.session_date, '%Y-%m')                     AS month,
               COUNT(*)                                                  AS sessions,
               ROUND(100.0 * SUM(a.status = 'PRESENT') / COUNT(*), 2)    AS attendance_pct
        FROM   attendance a
        JOIN   class_sessions cs ON cs.session_id = a.session_id
        GROUP  BY a.student_id, DATE_FORMAT(cs.session_date, '%Y-%m'))
SELECT s.roll_number,
       CONCAT(s.first_name, ' ', s.last_name)     AS student_name,
       m.month,
       m.sessions,
       m.attendance_pct,
       LAG(m.attendance_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY m.student_id ORDER BY m.month) AS previous_month,
       ROUND(m.attendance_pct - LAG(m.attendance_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY m.student_id ORDER BY m.month), 2) AS delta_points,
       CASE WHEN m.attendance_pct > LAG(m.attendance_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY m.student_id ORDER BY m.month) THEN 'IMPROVING'
            WHEN m.attendance_pct < LAG(m.attendance_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY m.student_id ORDER BY m.month) THEN 'DECLINING'
            ELSE 'FLAT' END                       AS trend
FROM   monthly m
JOIN   students s ON s.student_id = m.student_id
ORDER  BY s.roll_number, m.month DESC
LIMIT  60;

queries.title: Cross-module 360° snapshot of one student (parameterised)
queries.sql:
SET @sid = (SELECT student_id FROM students WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY student_id LIMIT 1);

SELECT 'PROFILE'     AS area, CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) AS metric, roll_number AS value FROM students WHERE student_id = @sid
UNION ALL SELECT 'PROGRAM', p.name, p.program_code FROM students s JOIN programs p ON p.program_id = s.program_id WHERE s.student_id = @sid
UNION ALL SELECT 'ATTENDANCE', 'overall %',
       CAST(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(a.status = 'PRESENT') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS CHAR) FROM attendance a WHERE a.student_id = @sid
UNION ALL SELECT 'FEES', 'outstanding', CAST(IFNULL(SUM(due_amount), 0) AS CHAR) FROM student_fees WHERE student_id = @sid AND status <> 'PAID'
UNION ALL SELECT 'FEES', 'paid', CAST(IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS CHAR) FROM payments WHERE student_id = @sid AND status = 'SUCCESS'
UNION ALL SELECT 'RESULTS', 'latest CGPA',
       CAST((SELECT r.cgpa FROM results r WHERE r.student_id = @sid
             ORDER BY r.published_on DESC, r.result_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS CHAR)
UNION ALL SELECT 'HOSTEL', 'hostel code',
       IFNULL((SELECT h.hostel_code FROM room_allocations ra JOIN hostels h ON h.hostel_id = ra.hostel_id
               WHERE ra.student_id = @sid AND ra.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1), 'DAY SCHOLAR')
UNION ALL SELECT 'ENROLLMENTS', 'active courses', CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) FROM enrollments WHERE student_id = @sid AND status = 'ACTIVE';

queries.title: Institute KPI card (the numbers on the dashboard) — single-row roll-up
queries.sql:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE status = 'ACTIVE')                              AS active_students,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faculty  WHERE status = 'ACTIVE')                              AS active_faculty,
       (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(status = 'PRESENT') / COUNT(*), 2) FROM attendance)        AS institute_attendance,
       (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payments WHERE status = 'SUCCESS')               AS fees_collected,
       (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(due_amount), 0) FROM student_fees WHERE status <> 'PAID')         AS fees_outstanding,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_allocations WHERE status = 'ACTIVE')                      AS hostel_residents,

         WHERE r.result_id = (SELECT r2.result_id FROM results r2 WHERE r2.student_id = r.student_id
                              ORDER BY r2.published_on DESC, r2.result_id DESC LIMIT 1))    AS average_cgpa,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_registrations WHERE is_eligible = 0)                      AS blocked_registrations,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faculty_leaves WHERE status = 'PENDING')                       AS pending_leaves,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_logs)                                                    AS audit_entries;

findings.title: Exam dues gate absent
findings.observation: sp_register_student_for_exam computes dues but does not reject on them; trigger eligibility is attendance/enrollment based.
findings.action: Centralize an approved eligibility policy; test positive-dues registration. Do not claim existing fee blocking.

findings.title: Attendance policy divergence
findings.observation: Exam procedure uses per-exam minimum; insert trigger uses global setting. UDF, monthly and overall reports differ on EXCUSED/no-data semantics.
findings.action: Agree one denominator, threshold and no-record contract and test boundaries.

findings.title: Refund amount versus full reversal
findings.observation: Refund service inserts a requested amount, then separately marks the whole payment REFUNDED; trigger reverses the entire original payment.
findings.action: Implement atomic full/partial/cumulative refund accounting and idempotency before acceptance.

findings.title: Payment concurrency and provisional receipt
findings.observation: Due check precedes transaction and initial receipt uses MAX(payment_id)+1; no observed row lock protects the precheck.
findings.action: Use bill locking and safe receipt/idempotency design; run competing-payment tests.

findings.title: Hostel target-student authorization
findings.observation: Application body studentId can override current student; history can select a supplied studentId.
findings.action: Enforce self-scope server-side for students and test two independent synthetic accounts.

findings.title: Allocation hierarchy and transfer consistency
findings.observation: No observed application-hostel/selected-bed-hostel equality check; transfer updates room/bed but not hostel_id.
findings.action: Validate the entire hierarchy and define or prohibit cross-hostel moves in one locked transaction.

findings.title: Faculty session ownership missing
findings.observation: Inspected marking controller/service checks roles but not that the faculty owns the session/offering.
findings.action: Enforce teaching ownership (with explicit administrative override) and run negative access tests.

findings.title: Mock answer-bank disclosure path
findings.observation: Question list/by-ID reads are authenticate-only; repository projections include correct_option and controller returns them. Paper omits answers, but that alone is insufficient.
findings.action: Restrict bank answers to staff or use a safe student projection; test API responses before submission.

findings.title: First-login server enforcement gap
findings.observation: Frontend password-change redirect exists, but authentication middleware does not deny other protected API calls for first-login users.
findings.action: Add a server-side first-login allowlist for me/change-password/logout and test direct API access.

findings.title: Result-filter columns absent
findings.observation: Optional semester filtering in ranking/subject-wise methods references columns absent from the respective views.
findings.action: Repair joins/filters or add an intentionally defined view projection; test filters both absent and supplied.

findings.title: Academic result formula assumptions
findings.observation: SGPA lacks the comment-claimed ENDSEM/pass filter; best-grade backlog/credits and all-result CGPA require institutional repeat-attempt policy.
findings.action: Obtain the approved grading policy and construct independent oracle fixtures.

findings.title: Payroll formula duplication
findings.observation: Inline procedure PF=12%; UDF reads faculty.pf_percent. Start-month attribution mishandles cross-month unpaid leave if calendar-day proration is intended.
findings.action: Agree policy and centralize implementation; test variable PF and cross-month leave.

findings.title: Payroll YTD/latest period view
findings.observation: Payroll sums labeled YTD have no payroll-year filter; independent MAX(year)/MAX(month) can name a nonexistent latest period.
findings.action: Use a defined year range and an ordered latest-row selection; test December/January fixtures.

findings.title: Hostel prechecks/reconciliation scope
findings.observation: Allocation prechecks precede transaction; final trigger-file reconciliation has no year scope and can overwrite reserved/maintenance bed states.
findings.action: Lock inventory and preserve non-occupancy operational states; test multiple years.

findings.title: Enrollment status/counter contract
findings.observation: Counters count all inserts/deletes, including non-active rows; status updates do not fire those counter triggers. Guard allows SUSPENDED students.
findings.action: Define physical-row versus active-enrollment counters and test drop/re-enroll updates.

findings.title: Database test drift / verdict capture
findings.observation: SQL admission approval fixture uses an old signature. runFile discards SELECT result sets; SQL assertion failures are not reliably converted to failing process status.
findings.action: Fix current signature, capture assertion rows and fail the runner when any assertion fails.

findings.title: API smoke authorization expectation drift
findings.observation: The student /students expectation must be reconciled with current route authorization before claiming a passing suite.
findings.action: Review expected policy, update the test where approved and retain raw HTTP evidence.

findings.title: Fee notification alias mismatch
findings.observation: Finance notification code reads fee_code while the repository exposes feeCode.
findings.action: Align the alias and test the notification text without exposing personal data.

findings.title: AI policy/model claims
findings.observation: Local planner hardcodes 75% and a priority-item heuristic; it is not identical to SQL weighted student risk. Optional provider calls are unverified.
findings.action: Label LOCAL_ENGINE/provider/fallback and distinguish model outputs and policy versions.

findings.title: Container initialization is a different path
findings.observation: Compose mounts numeric SQL files in filename order; the supported TS runner loads functions/views before seeds/procedures/triggers. Compatibility/order cannot be assumed equivalent.
findings.action: Verify a clean disposable container boot or replace with an explicit dependency-aware initializer.

findings.title: Runtime institution/year defaults do not match report context
findings.observation: 03_constraints.sql includes a different long institute name and CURRENT_ACADEMIC_YEAR=2025-26. Report identity/year comes from supplied PICT templates (2026-2027), not this seed setting.
findings.action: Have the team approve/reset institutional settings and active year flags; do not silently rewrite repository evidence.

findings.title: Documentation TLS drift
findings.observation: README says pool TLS/CA settings are absent, but the application pool now reads DB_SSL_CA with certificate validation. The SQL runner does not mirror that option.
findings.action: Treat current code as primary; align documentation and test both connection paths without disclosing CA/credentials.

findings.title: Cross-role analytical data scope
findings.observation: Every permitted staff report role can choose any catalog key; global search is authenticate-only over students/faculty/payments/admissions. Row/role-specific data minimization is not evident.
findings.action: Agree a report-key and row-scope permission matrix; redact salary/financial/contact fields for unrelated roles.

findings.title: Payslip-by-ID ownership
findings.observation: Faculty-accessible payroll by-ID reads need a self-owner predicate; role membership alone does not establish ownership of the chosen payroll ID.
findings.action: Enforce payroll.faculty_id=current actor for FACULTY and test another synthetic faculty payslip.

findings.title: Mock multi-statement workflow atomicity
findings.observation: Attempt insertion/question selection and grade/finalize operations are separate repository statements without an observed encompassing transaction.
findings.action: Use transactions and idempotent finalization; test failure between stages and mutable question-bank effects.

findings.title: Analytics source-quality exceptions
findings.observation: Q02 compares offering state to ACTIVE, Q44 compares enrollment state to ACTIVE: validate against actual ENUMs. Q14 capacity can fan out; Q23 compares dates directly to timestamps; Q35 claims dues blocking; Q37 includes future dues in 0-30. Q43 comment overclaims CUBE/GROUPING SETS.
findings.action: Treat all 45 examples as source artifacts requiring semantic/runtime review; do not report invented outputs or capabilities.

findings.title: Broadcast read-state is shared
findings.observation: A NULL-user notification is a single broadcast row; mark-read updates that shared row, rather than a per-recipient receipt table.
findings.action: Define broadcast read semantics; add per-recipient receipt state only as a proposed future design.

findings.title: Fee generator category/scholarship selection
findings.observation: Generator chooses only category_id IS NULL structure; it prevents any second student/semester bill and applies year-matched scholarship rows without sanction-status filtering or explicit multiple-award aggregation.
findings.action: Define category precedence and sanctioned-award aggregation; test multiple awards, cancelled awards and separate fee structures.

findings.title: Bulk attendance input/count semantics
findings.observation: Procedure parses CSV IDs with one shared status; API serializes an array. Empty token stops the loop and p_marked counts processed tokens including repeats.
findings.action: Test malformed/duplicate CSV and report token count separately from distinct affected rows.

findings.title: Bulk enrollment cohort and cleanup scope
findings.observation: Students are filtered by program/ACTIVE, not batch or section membership; section filters offerings. Capacity precheck may reject duplicate-only reruns; exception handler does not explicitly drop the Memory temporary table.
findings.action: Define intended cohort filters and staging cleanup; test full capacity and pooled-connection reuse.

findings.title: Exemption/publication path limitations
findings.observation: Registration procedure has no exemption input and low-attendance rollback creates no row to update. Results processing stamps published_on separately from exam publication; no observed marks procedure/trigger guard blocks published-exam edits despite a service comment.
findings.action: Define a complete condonation workflow and result/marks freeze/visibility policy; implement and test explicit server/DB guards.

findings.title: Leave overlap and payroll detail gaps
findings.observation: No observed leave-overlap guard exists. Approval balance UDF subtracts all pending days including the current request before comparing to its days. Payroll components omit special allowance, income-tax and LOP entries; PAID guard is only a state-transition/negative-net check.
findings.action: Implement approved overlap/reservation logic, complete payslip components and precise paid-record immutability; run independent oracle tests.

findings.title: Build is not functional validation
findings.observation: Four typecheck/build commands pass. Vitest exits 1 because no test files are found; no live DB/API/E2E or deployment execution was performed.
findings.action: Supply independent, sanitized SQL/API evidence before calling the ERP tested or deployed successfully.
